user.title: Connect SmartThings (OAuth2)
user.description:
**Before continuing, create a SmartThings API App using the SmartThings CLI:**

1. Go to [{cli_url}]({cli_url}) and download `smartthings.msi` (Windows).
2. Install `smartthings.msi`.
3. Open **Command Prompt as Administrator**.
4. Run:
   ```
   smartthings apps:create
   ```
5. Follow the guided prompts. Select the scopes: `r:devices:*` e `x:devices:*`. When asked for the **Redirect URI**, paste exactly this (copy it from here, it must match character for character):

   `{redirect_uri}`

6. At the end the CLI will show you the **Client ID** and **Client Secret** (shown only once: copy them right away). Enter them below.

authorize.title: Authorize the app on SmartThings
authorize.description:
Click the link below: it will open the SmartThings consent screen with the fields already pre-filled (client, redirect URI, permissions).

[👉 Open the SmartThings authorization link]({auth_url})

After logging in and clicking **Authorize**, the browser will try to load a redirect page (it's normal to get an error like "page not found": that's not a problem).

**Check your browser's address bar right away**: it will contain something like `...?code=XXXXXXXX`. Copy only the value after `code=` and paste it below **within a few seconds**: the code can only be used once and expires very quickly. If it expires, go back and regenerate the link.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Samsung Windfree Avant
reauth_confirm.description:
Authentication with SmartThings is no longer valid (refresh token expired or revoked). Check the Client ID and Client Secret (leave them unchanged if they haven't changed) and continue to re-authorize the app.

Redirect URI to use if you need to recreate the SmartThings API App:

`{redirect_uri}`

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Samsung Windfree Avant
reconfigure.description:
Update the Client ID / Client Secret if needed and re-authorize the app on SmartThings.

Redirect URI to use if you need to recreate the SmartThings API App:

`{redirect_uri}`

error.auth_failed: Code exchange failed. Check the Home Assistant logs for details, or the code may have expired: try again with a new one.
